# Diona
## General Information
Diona have plant-like metabolisms, getting [color=lightgreen]hungry slower[/color] than other species, but getting [color=lightblue]thirsty faster[/color].
They metabolize reagents in one organ (similar to slimes), up to six reagents per stage (digestion, bloodstream, and metabolites).
They have [color=peachpuff]sap[/color] rather than blood, which replenishes when metabolizing iron. [color=peachpuff]Sap[/color] is slightly nutritious when consumed by other species, though drinking the blood of your coworkers is usually frowned upon.
They take [color=#1e90ff]30% less Blunt damage[/color] and [color=#1e90ff]20% less Slash damage[/color], but [color=#ffa500]50% more Heat damage[/color] and [color=#ffa500]20% more Shock damage[/color]. Their bark-like skin can [color=#ffa500]easily catch fire[/color] when receiving enough Heat damage from [italic]any[/italic] source.[/color]
They [color=#1e90ff]suffocate twice as slow[/color] as most other species.
They have [color=gray]large, dense bodies[/color], and are [color=gray]heavier to drag[/color] around.
## Rooting
Diona move around using a dense network of roots. [color=palevioletred]This prevents them from wearing [italic]any[/italic] footwear[/color], but these roots also allow a diona to [color=lightgreen]firmly root themselves to the ground[/color].
While rooted, a diona [color=#ffa500]moves 20% slower[/color], but is able to freely move around in zero-gravity environments instead of awkwardly floating around. Being rooted also causes a diona to passively absorb reagents from puddles they're standing in. This can potentially be dangerous if they're standing in something unsafe to drink!
## Botanical Reagents
While diona can digest the same foods that most other species can, they're also affected by certain botanical reagents. [color=lightgreen]Fertilizers[/color] will sate their hunger, but [color=orchid]pesticides[/color] will poison them!
[color=lightgreen]Robust harvest[/color] (an especially potent fertilizer) will [color=lightgreen]heal a diona's injuries[/color], but [color=orchid]overdosing[/color] will cause them to grow out of control, [color=orchid]turning into an immobile tree[/color] (and dropping all their equipment). Cutting down the tree will "restore" the Diona to their regular, mobile state.
## Nymphs
After death, a Diona can voluntarily destroy their own body, releasing their internal organs as three "nymphs", with the player taking control of the nymph containing the brain. The brain nymph can speak, but has no hands or inventory.
After [color=lightgreen]10 minutes[/color], the brain nymph can [color=lightgreen]regrow[/color] into a "full" Diona. This will be a [color=palevioletred]brand-new body[/color] with a new name, appearance, fingerprints, and even DNA, leaving little evidence about who they were before.
